joint_results.title: P1 least-closure and minimum certificate definition
worked_manual_attack: For SYN-A let f1=x^2 and f2=xy-1. At budget 2 the complete closed space is span{x^2,xy-1}; it contains no nonzero lower-degree combination. Budgets 0 and 1 contain no eligible inputs. The functional with lambda(1)=lambda(xy)=1 and all other degree-at-most-3 monomial coordinates zero annihilates the budget-2 space and separates target 1. These are manual protocol checks, not run certificates.

At budget 3, y*f1-x*f2=x. Multiplying that consequence by y is admissible and gives xy; subtracting f2 yields 1. The retained expansion 1=y^2*f1-(xy+1)*f2 uses product degree 4. Thus a derivation node must preserve degree history instead of equating its admissible output degree with expanded product degree.

The same functional annihilates the full raw U_3: its six generating products are x^2,xy-1,x^3,x^2*y,x^2*y-x,x*y^2-y. It separates 1, so U_3 cannot certify V_3. The explicit missing product is y*x=xy, where x is already in U_3 and deg(x)+deg(y)=2<=3. A weak checker testing only initial-row inclusion, rank and this separator would falsely accept the smaller space; the registered product-completeness check must reject it. The displayed degree-4 expansion supplies raw membership, while the raw lower-rung separations prevent a false raw minimum 3.
For SYN-B, (x^2-1)-(x^2-2)=1 in each declared field, including F2. No inputs occur below degree 2. A/B output degree 0 therefore cannot determine the respective earliest derivation degrees.

For an arbitrary degree-cancelling combination, a basis of V_E intersect A_d for every d covers its true degree. Multiplication of each such basis vector by every admissible monomial, plus linearity, supplies closure for every vector. Derivation circuits give one inclusion; certified input/product closure gives the reverse inclusion with the least closed space.

An adapted basis with independent birth cosets yields the max-birth formula for every nonzero linear combination: a nonzero component in the largest birth quotient cannot cancel into the previous space. Complete maps, full ambient embeddings and every lower-rung dual are explicitly required.
joint_results.reason: The frozen definition and checker obligations defeat the worked incomplete-span and wrong-minimum attacks. Ordinary, one-shot, expanded and Q degrees remain different coordinates. This judges the mathematical protocol interface only.
joint_results.execution_limitation: No engine, certificate checker, rank computation or formal theorem was executed.

joint_results.title: P2 source panels, endpoint and ordinary/Q scope
worked_manual_attack: Inspected all 510 frozen rows by a lossless display grouped into their 85 public parameter cells, retaining every actual variant and seed. SYN=40, L=12, BOOL=80 and S3=378; source=12+3+16+54=85; null=425; calibration=40+8+40+189=277 and holdout=4+40+189=233. Thirteen units each carry five extra verifier mutations, for 65 checks outside the scientific slot denominator.

The shared_core hash-key rule supplies exactly the same BOOL source/null core to O and Q. The F2 exact-support null is correctly an identical control; the three support-randomized arms match per-equation degree histograms and are separately labelled. No IID sample claim or field transfer is licensed.

Directly compared both S3 formulas against the typeset Semaev Section 2. The odd model has characteristic at least 5; the supplied primes and short-Weierstrass model match that interface. The binary model uses a1=1,a3=a4=0 and the correct B term. Algebraic roots, rational lifts, signs and affine intermediate-u scope are kept distinct. Eligibility failures cannot alter the fixed denominator.

Read the native first-fall definition and Example 4.4 including the supplied page 13 addendum. The L system is ordinary F_q[w,x,y,z] without extra field equations. Its separate top ring is the q-power nilpotent quotient; original generator shifts survive even when w^q maps to zero. Complete syzygy/trivial-image slices are required. The future finite q=3,5,7 checks do not establish an all-q result.

Challenged root-count inference: the L null endpoint keeps the ordinary ideal and verifies mutual membership plus all S-pairs; a lack of F_q roots cannot make its ideal unit. For split squarefree S3/BOOL grids, full evaluations plus explicit Lagrange and membership-division witnesses justify ideal-piece equality. Equal dimensions or root counts alone are refused.

Checked the global-degree interface against the primary proofs: a complete degree-compatible GB and each required delta precede the ordinary last-fall and solving-degree formulas. Full fall slices extend beyond K. A quiet window, endpoint rank or a quotient result cannot substitute for those premises.

The equal-Hilbert control has an unresolved graded-object convention. The degree-0 discriminator gives 0 for J and 1 for R/J, while the displayed series is the latter and the source wording names the ideals. This leaves the actual finite numeric metric and formal target underdetermined.
joint_results.reason: The panel and endpoint/scope interfaces otherwise hold at protocol level, but P2-HILBERT-OBJECT prevents the owned joint from being fully explicit and ready.
joint_results.corrective_prerequisite: Add a prospective, hash-bound amendment that names R=k[x,y,h], selects H_(R/J) or H_J explicitly for every SYN A/B/CI finite Hilbert array and sameHomogeneousHilbertSeries target, supplies the corresponding formula, and requires the degree-0 ideal/quotient discriminator. Preserve the original records and all fixed scientific slots. A convenient resolution is to retain the displayed quotient formula while naming R/J and optionally retain the complementary ideal series.

joint_results.title: P3 full cost, formal and lifecycle completeness
worked_manual_attack: Tried to hide SYN-A expanded degree 4 behind a degree-3 circuit. The protocol separately charges and retains the DAG, expanded multiplier coefficients, E_exp, every lower-rung space and dual, checker scratch, endpoint work, serialization and spill. Full field-operation vectors, coefficient growth, CPU/wall and live/RSS/storage costs remain required. W is explicitly a unit-weight proxy, not bit complexity or a measured speedup.

Cold, incremental and raw comparators have separate accounting. Reuse must retain original derivations and pay construction, retention and rechecking. Endpoints cannot guide measured closure or target choice; standalone endpoint/checking costs remain charged for each strategy.

The formal plan names an actual polynomial closed-basis/minimum theorem and concrete SYN-A/B minimum, raw-degree and homogeneous-Hilbert obligations. An abstract implication assuming the answer or an unrelated module cannot satisfy the target. Exact toolchain/dependency/source pins, requested theorem axiom audits and independent semantic QA are later mandatory gates. The P2 Hilbert convention correction must reach that concrete target before it can be qualified.

Inspected the 22-card prospective chain: source design snapshot, this independent review and snapshot, separate approval, implementation and snapshot, formal preparation/attempt with snapshots, independent operational/semantic QA, decision-only QA archive, separate launch/lock publication, science/run snapshot, actual claim and statement-only packet, three independent evidence joints, then the Coordinator evidence ledger. Direct implementation/formal/scientific producer dependencies accompany the relevant review snapshots.

Archive source_task_ids bind the producer outputs, and science owns 13 named files per each of 13 units (169 named output paths). The QA archive owns its DEC and no invented EV; static dispatcher lines 576-603 permit a decision-only ledger, requiring an evidence artifact when an EV is named.

The custom profile must bind the actual mapped plan, full transitive source closure, interpreter/dependencies, external expected LOCKED SHA and current owner/epoch before scientific import. All twelve administrative QA cases are prescribed. Existing shared-runner failures/tests are not accepted as qualification; this review does not run those cases or approve the runner.
joint_results.reason: No separate omission was found in the full-cost and prospective formal/lifecycle safeguards. Their mandatory later evidence remains absent by design. P3 holding does not discharge P2 or admit any implementation or measurement.
joint_results.execution_limitation: Implementation, formal, QA, lock/launch and science remain future, separately admitted actions.
